flow-definition.description: calendar-publisher (DAYTRADE-778). Publishes fmp_earnings_calendar (portfolio + active earnings_wk) and fmp_economic_calendar (US) into the shared Earnings / Economic Indicator calendars on calendar.franklinfinancial.ai, -7/+90 days. Hourly; writes only new/changed events and deletes stale ones, so a quiet run takes seconds. Safe to run by hand at any time. Pipeline logic lives in git: Franklin-Digital/Radicale @ franklin_1.0prod, franklin/deploy/jenkins/calendar-publisher.groovy. This job is the ONLY scheduler - do not re-add the systemd timer.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: DRY_RUN
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Compute and log new / changed / stale counts, write nothing. Scheduled runs use the default (false).

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: FORCE
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Re-PUT every event even if unchanged. About 10 minutes. Only needed if the server content is suspected wrong in a way the comparison cannot see.

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: ONLY
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: Publish both calendars, or just one.
